sections.Profile:
"College Daze" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in August 1949. Designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker, the game features two flippers, two pop bumpers, three passive bumpers, and two kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1949
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, College, Wood Rail, Sports, Original Theme, Football
